sn48.4:1.4: yato ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti.
sn48.4:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
